title: Protecting Critical Infrastructure: What Is Indispensable
goal: I can say what is indispensable for a whole system (*Elengedhetetlen biztosítani …*, *A mérnököknek elengedhetetlen felkészülniük …*).
I can talk about critical infrastructure and the power grid (*kritikus infrastruktúra*, *üzemfolytonosság*, *redundáns architektúra*).
I can say that a network needs reserve systems.
